title: The count beneath the route beside the road
body: A road is rubbed out on the map, while six small figures remain beside it. The pencil has worn through the paper at the place where they waited. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.

title: A tally without passengers beside the road
body: The board lists four vehicle numbers and no names. An erased fifth line still bears the pressure of a child’s small handwriting. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.

title: Supplies for an empty seat beside the road
body: The sealed kit is tied to a towel marked for a passenger. The seat allocation has been crossed off, though the towel is still damp. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.

title: Two directions in one fold beside the road
body: The loose page gives a route at odds with the one inked on the map. Someone has traced both with a finger stained from a lunch wrapper. The string has been retied since morning.

title: The lamp after closing beside the road
body: The battery is taped to a torch beside a handwritten departure time. Its owner waited long enough to use up the spare. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.

title: An unissued place in line beside the road
body: A badge and a band for counting arrivals are tied together. The band has an extra notch that never made it onto the badge. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.

title: The second signal beside the road

title: One more household beside the road

title: Packed for the wrong stop beside the road
